newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Major announcement by Mobutu likely soon -S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Major announcement by Mobutu likely soon -S.Africa.

text.p: President Mobutu Sese Seko of Zaire will make a major announcement on the war in his country possibly by the end of the day, a South African envoy said on Monday.
Anthony Mongalo, deputy director-general of the department of foreign affairs, made the remarks to a parliamentary committee after accompanying Deputy President Thabo Mbeki to Zaire at the weekend.

Mongalo said Mbeki delivered a letter from President Nelson Mandela to Mobutu urging him to make greater efforts towards peace. The South Africans were informed that Mobutu would make an important announcement within 48 hours, he said.
"Possibly even by this evening, he will have made those announcements which we hope will be leading us to finding a solution to that problem there," Mongalo said.
Mbeki has been at the heart of a bid by South African President Nelson Mandela to broker peace between the two sides.
Rebel leader Laurent Kabila has resisted sustained diplomatic pressure for an immediate ceasefire and talks on Zaire's future.
